title: Confidentiality.
bodyText: Reports provided to the department under this section shall not be made public to protect the identity of the persons diagnosed to be suffering from an environmentally-related illness or injury; provided that statistical information collected under this part shall be public information.
bodyHtml: [§321-315]  Confidentiality.  Reports provided to the department under this section shall not be made public to protect the identity of the persons diagnosed to be suffering from an environmentally-related illness or injury; provided that statistical information collected under this part shall be public information. [L 1987, c 186, pt of §2]
